The '''Kanz sector''', also known as the '''Argazdan Redoubt''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to both the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] and [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] species from [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] and [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] respectively.

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3970 BBY]], the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Myrialites]] under Provisional [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Myrial]] of [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] seceeded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and claimed some of the sector as the [[Argazdan Redoubt]]. Myrialite forces invaded planets that resisted her reign over the Kanz sector including [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] during the "[[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]]." Due to their support for the [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltannan]] resistance, Myrial had the Lorrdians [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]].

For three centuries, the Myrialites ruled the Kanz sector. Any attempt by the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to intervene was cut short by the various conflicts of the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the resurgent threat of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The Lorrdian captives, forbidden by their masters from speaking aloud, developed a form of nonverbal communication that remained in use afterwards.

In [[3670 BBY]], a Jedi and Republic task force under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] intervened and defeated the Argazdan slave lords after dogged fighting. However, by then, more than 5 billion had been killed including 500 million Lorrdians. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Kanz sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Nee Alavar/Legends|Nee Alavar]].<ref name="db" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], most contemporary Lorrdians and Argazdans got on well since most Argazdans regarded the actions of the Myrialites as shameful.

==History==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] sought to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|year]] [[4200 BBY]] to protect themselves from the [[Ereesi/Legends|Ereesi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. and the area was admitted by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as the Kanz sector, partly due to the population's origins from a lost colonization attempt of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Republic repulsed the Ereesi until Argazda was ready for self-defense, but the conservative Argazdan population found Republic culture immoral and offensive. Circa [[3970 BBY]], [[Governor/Legends|Provisional Governor]] [[Myrial]] declared the Kanz sector independent, renaming it the Argazdan Redoubt. Those loyal to the Republic were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in mass executions, while an Argazdan battle fleet annihilated all life on [[Ereesus]]. The revolution did not trigger a Republic response due to it being preoccupied with the [[Mandalorian Wars]], which allowed the [[Myrialites]] to retain power for three centuries, bombing worlds and slaying entire populations. Until the toppling of the regime by the reformed [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[3670 BBY]], the loss of lives exceeded five billion.<ref name="TEA" />
